title: umto_chorale — harmonization mode
description: Figured-bass/Roman-numeral realization exercise. Student sees a grand staff with bass line and analysis overlays (figured bass or Roman numerals). Bass voice is locked — grader provides it automatically. Student plays the upper voices to complete each sonority. Graded slice-by-slice by HarmonizationGrader: checks allowed pitch classes, required upper pitch classes, and voice count policy.

clef.description: Harmonization exercises always use grand staff (keyboard) layout: bass on bass staff, upper voices on treble.

analysisType.description: Controls overlay type. 'figured_bass' shows thoroughbass figures. 'roman' shows Roman numerals.

grading.description: One GradingSlice per onset window. Each slice holds all four SATB MIDI pitches of the target sonority (including bass). HarmonizationGrader extracts locked voices and derives allowedPcs/requiredUpperPcs from analysis slices.

target_midi_pitches.description: Full SATB sonority at this onset. Includes locked-voice pitches. Non-chord-tone (NCT) slices are skipped during generation.

locked_voices.description: Voices the grader provides. Student does not play these. Typically ['B'].

min.description: Minimum voices student must play simultaneously.

expected.description: Exact voice count if strict voicing is required.

source.description: Which label type in analysis[].content drives target computation in harmonization_targets_logic.js. 'analysis_slice' means the full AnalysisSlice is used.

written_spelling_required.description: If true, student must play specific enharmonic spellings, not just pitch classes.

midi_uses_pitch_class.description: If true, grader compares played notes as pitch classes (mod 12) against target. Allows any octave register.

chord_settle_ms.description: Milliseconds a held sonority must be stable before grader evaluates it.

voices.description: Full SATB voice streams. Bass voice is rendered but locked during grading.

B.description: Bass line with figured bass or Roman numeral overlays. Locked.

analysis.description: One AnalysisSlice per harmonic onset. Content drives the overlay shown to student AND the allowedPcs/requiredUpperPcs computation. NCT slices (non-chord-tone offsets) are skipped during generation.

figured_bass.description: Abbreviated Kellner figure shown to student (e.g. '', '7', '6', '4/2').

raw_figured_bass.description: Full unabbreviated stack (e.g. '8/5/3', '7/5/3'). Used internally for allowedPcs derivation.

x-grading-algorithm.description: HarmonizationGrader slice evaluation (harmonization_grader_logic.js). At each onset window:
steps: 1. Extract locked-voice pitch classes from grading slice target_midi_pitches.
2. Derive allowedPcs from analysis[offset].content (all chord tones at this harmony).
3. Derive requiredUpperPcs = allowedPcs minus locked-voice pitch classes.
4. When student releases notes, check: (a) locked pcs present, (b) no illegal pcs played, (c) all requiredUpperPcs covered, (d) voice count in [min, max].
5. If all pass: advance to next window. Else: flash error, stay on window.
